compose_gtn_graphs: compose two weighted finite-state transducer graphs using gtn.compose to chain input and output symbols
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a graph using gtn.forward_score to get log-sum-exp over all paths
find_viterbi_path: find the highest-scoring path through a graph using gtn.viterbi_path and gtn.viterbi_score
union_concat_closure_graphs: build graph operations with gtn.union for sum, gtn.concat for concatenation, and gtn.closure for Kleene star
remove_epsilon_transitions: remove epsilon transitions from a graph using gtn.remove to simplify the automaton structure
